description: 서울시설공단_도로시설처 소관 법정시설물 현황 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울시설공단. 한강교량, 일반교량, 터널, 고가차도, 입체교차, 지하차도, 언더패스, 복개구조에 대한 노선정보와 시설물 연장(길이) 및 준공일과 공용년수, 시설물 안전등급 현황 등 법정시설물에 대한. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울시설공단. Its tags are 서울시, 자동차전용도로, 도로시설물, 시설물, 시설연장. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
